levels.name: Until the flag
levels.hint: Repeat until flag keeps going until the robot is on the flag.

levels.name: Clear ahead?
levels.hint: If the way ahead is clear, go Forward. If not, turn right.

levels.name: Snail shell
levels.hint: The same four blocks can follow the whole spiral. Let If decide!

levels.name: Gem signs
levels.hint: Keep walking. Each time the robot finds a gem, it turns right.

levels.name: Walls and gems
levels.hint: A wall ahead means turn left. A gem means turn right.

levels.name: Left or right?
levels.hint: At a corner try left. If left is blocked too, turn round to face right.

levels.name: Rocky road
levels.sol: u(i(F)(L F R F F R F L))
levels.hint: When a rock is in the way, step up, go past it and come back down.

levels.name: Long maze
levels.hint: A big maze, but the program from Left or right? still works.

levels.name: Look left
levels.hint: New block: If path left. The robot can look sideways as it walks!

levels.name: Look right
levels.hint: Now meet If path right. Which way do these side paths go?

levels.name: Stay on the road
levels.hint: The little loops skip the gems. At a wall, which way is open?

levels.name: Side streets
levels.hint: Turn into each side street, but only once. The else part can help!

levels.name: Gem town
levels.hint: Each gem says turn here. The walls say which way.

levels.name: Wall walker
levels.hint: In a maze, keep your left hand on the wall and you will never get lost.

levels.name: Frog pond
levels.hint: Round and round the pond! Which hand should touch the wall this time?

levels.name: Which hand?
levels.hint: One hand finds the flag too soon. Which hand gets the gems first?

levels.name: Round trip
levels.hint: The flag is just behind you. Fetch the gems first, then come back!

levels.name: Crystal cave
levels.hint: Wide tunnels, but a hand on the wall still finds the way. Which hand?

levels.name: No looking ahead
levels.hint: No If path ahead today. Can you keep a hand on the wall without it?

levels.name: Maze master
levels.hint: One short program can solve any maze. You know it already!
